structural_match: meethub is explicitly modeled on Meetup.com (RSVP-based Event/Category/Account with an attendees M2M and comments), not Eventbrite -- there is no Ticket model, no price/quantity field, and no payment flow anywhere in the codebase. As an event-ticketing exemplar match it is weak: free RSVP attendance, not paid ticket sales.
